title_en: Artificial Intelligence (2/20): A Driverless Car in the City
note_en: 地 (de) turns an adjective into an adverb describing how something is done, much like English -ly: 安静地穿过繁忙的街道 "quietly passes through the busy streets." It sounds exactly like 的, but 的 links a description to a noun (繁忙的街道), while 地 links it to a verb. A third de, 得, comes after the verb: 车开得又平稳又谨慎 "the car drove smoothly and carefully."
